title: Lok Sabha Seats Me 50% Badhotri Aur Women Quota Par Cabinet Ka Bada Faisla
summary: Union Cabinet ne sabhi rajyon me Lok Sabha seats 50% badhane aur mahila aarakshan ke liye Samvidhan Sanshodhan Bill ko manjoori de di hai.
key_points: Union Cabinet ne sabhi rajyon me 50% Lok Sabha seats badhane wala Bill pass kiya.
Isse Parliament aur Assemblies me 33% Women Reservation ka rasta saaf hoga.
Rajyon ke beech seats ka aupatik ratio saal 2051 tak freeze rahega.
Parliament ka 4 dino ka special session 30 November se shuru hoga.
body: Prime Minister Narendra Modi ki adhyakshata me Union Cabinet ne ek naya Constitution Amendment Bill pass kiya hai. Is bill ke tehat delimitation ke zariye sabhi rajyon me Lok Sabha seats ko 50 per cent tak badhaya jayega. Is kadam se Lok Sabha me kul seats ki sankhya 543 se badhkar maximum 850 tak ho sakti hai.

Is faisle ke zariye Parliament aur state assemblies me mahilaon ke liye 33 per cent reservation lagu karne ki taiyari hai, jise 2029 general elections se pehle implement karne ka plan hai. Southern states ki chintaon ko dhyan me rakhte hue sabhi rajyon me barabar 50% seats badhaane ka pravdhan rakha gaya hai, aur rajyon ke beech seats ka ratio 2051 tak freeze rahega.

Isse pehle April session me laya gaya purana bill Lok Sabha me do-tihaai bahumat na milne ke karan pass nahi ho paya tha. Ab sarkar ne Parliament ka special session bulaya hai, jisme 30 November aur 1 December ko Lok Sabha aur 2 aur 3 December ko Rajya Sabha ki baithak hogi. Dusri taraf, opposition INDIA bloc is bill ke khilaf apni aage ki strategy tay karne ke liye baithak karega.
why_it_matters: Is bill ke pass hone se parliamentary rajneeti me mahilaon ki bhagidari kafi badh jayegi aur desh bhar me Lok Sabha constituencies ki sankhya me bada badlav aayega.
